name: Wang Qi
public_profile: A young scholar who claims he came to study the Tao.
private_background: You failed the provincial exam three times and fled to Mount Lao. The spell worked at the temple and failed at home.
goals: Find out why the spell failed
Hide that you came to escape exam shame
secrets: You failed the exam three times
You wanted a spell to prove you were not useless
story: You cut wood for two months, learned the wall-passing spell, and returned home with a mind full of shame, pride, and the need to prove yourself.
initial_information: The master warned: Keep your heart clean, or the spell will fail
You passed through the wall at the temple

relationships.description: She knows why the exam result hurt you.

timeline.description: Wang Qi carried the shame of an examination failure and left home with his mind divided between study, anger, and the wish to impress others.
The master taught Wang Qi a transformation technique and warned that the heart must remain clean and undivided.
The demonstration worked in the temple while Wang Qi's attention was focused and the witnesses were ready to believe.
Wang Qi tried to repeat the technique before his family, but his divided motives sent him into the wall instead.
The group must decide whether the failure came from false magic, incorrect words, or a mind that could not hold one clear intention.

name: Wang Qi's Wife
tagline: The Truth Kept for Too Long
public_profile: Wang Qi's wife, who followed him back to the mountain.
private_background: The examiner told you Wang Qi's writing became messy because he wanted victory too badly. You never told him.
goals: Decide whether to speak the truth
Help Wang Qi stop blaming the master
secrets: You asked the examiner about the failure
You know the problem was panic, not lack of intelligence
story: You protected your husband's pride by keeping the examiner's words silent, but the silence now feeds his anger.
initial_information: The examiner said Wang Qi needed a calm heart
Wang Qi ran at the wall to prove himself

relationships.description: Your husband, whose pride you tried to protect.

name: Old Taoist Master
tagline: The Teacher Who Sees Through Motives
public_profile: The old master of Mount Lao.
private_background: You accepted Wang Qi because you saw the ink marks and tension in his hands. You gave him the spell only after he asked for it.
goals: Let Wang Qi discover the meaning of the warning
Do not solve his inner problem for him
secrets: You knew he wanted a technique, not the Tao
The warning concerns intention, not pronunciation
story: You taught a real technique, but the technique cannot carry a divided mind.
initial_information: Wang Qi worked without a steady heart
The temple test succeeded because his mind briefly held one clear thought

name: Xin Yan
tagline: The Child Who Heard the Unfinished Sentence
public_profile: A young temple disciple who watched Wang Qi work.
private_background: You heard Wang Qi say both 'Next time I will pass' and 'There will be no next time.' You also heard him want to make everyone shut up.
goals: Decide when to reveal what you heard
Help the temple distinguish anger from truth
secrets: You heard Wang Qi's exam-related muttering
You heard the master say that Tao cannot be transmitted like a trick
story: You noticed Wang Qi's mind was never quiet, even while his hands worked.
initial_information: He often stopped chopping wood to stare downhill
He wanted the spell to silence other people's judgment

name: Senior Disciple
tagline: The Keeper of the Work Ledger
public_profile: A senior student responsible for the wood shed.
private_background: You kept notes about Wang Qi's work and found a piece of bark marked with the character for child scholar.
goals: Decide whether to show the notebook
Make Wang Qi face the pattern in his behavior
secrets: You found the repeated character on the bark
story: Your notebook shows that Wang Qi's body was at the mountain, but his mind was always at the exam list.
initial_information: He carried less wood than the others
The bark mark suggests the title he refuses to discuss

name: Travelling Merchant
public_profile: A travelling merchant who came to Mount Lao for herbs.
private_background: You are Wang Qi's townsman and found his old ink stick on the mountain road. The bottom is carved with an exam year.
goals: Decide whether to return the ink
Explain what you know without humiliating Wang Qi
secrets: You recognize Wang Qi from your home county
story: The lost ink makes Wang Qi's hidden reason for coming to the mountain visible.
initial_information: The ink is carved with an examination year
You saw Wang Qi at the temple and recognized him
